summary: header avatar shows '?' when Clerk has no first/last name
description:
The header avatar in the top-right corner renders the literal character `?` for users whose Clerk profile has no firstName/lastName. This is the common case for email-only signups and many social providers — the user reported it from a live session.

Source of the fallback:

  src/components/nav-bar.tsx:66
    const initials = [user?.firstName, user?.lastName]
      .filter(Boolean).map(n => n![0]).join('') || '?';

Fix shape (open to either approach):

  1. Cascade fallbacks: firstName/lastName → first letter of
     primaryEmailAddress → generic person glyph (SVG). The email
     letter covers ~all real users; the glyph covers the
     pre-load / unauthenticated-render edge case.

  2. Use a generic SVG person icon when no name is set and skip
     the email-letter step entirely.

Approach 1 is more personal and matches what most consumer apps
do (Gmail, GitHub). Recommend it.

Done when:
  - No '?' character appears in the avatar regardless of which
    Clerk fields are populated.
  - Tested locally with a Clerk user that has only an email
    (no first/last name).
  - Avatar still opens the account menu on click; sizing
    unchanged (28x28 desktop).
